resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2028 supported. The dead Aramco press release said MGS Phase 3 raises capacity by 3.15 bscfd 'by 2028' with construction from Q2 2024 to Q4 2028. worldoil.com reprints the Aramco announcement ('by 2028'); pipeline-journal.net (independent L&T contractor coverage of MGS Package 8) states the programme aims to be complete 'by 2028' — both verified OK/200 with token '2028' present. SPA (Saudi Press Agency) N2131194 also carries '2028' as an additional official confirmation. In-service 2028 is a target completion, consistent with StartYear1=2028.

StartCountryOrArea=EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia supported. MEED verified OK/200 with token 'EWPS' present — it describes the east-west gas pipeline packages laying 56-inch lines from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8 (the exact segment), all within Saudi Arabia's east-west corridor / Eastern Province. pipeline-journal.net verified OK/200 with token 'Saudi' present, describing the MGS Phase 3 East-West Pipeline system across Saudi Arabia. The full MGS III network is domestic Saudi infrastructure; no cross-border segment.

Owner1=Aramco 100% supported. The Master Gas System is Aramco's wholly-owned domestic gas network; the Phase 3 expansion contracts were awarded by Aramco to EPC contractors (who are builders, not owners). worldoil.com verified OK/200 with token 'Master Gas' present, attributing the MGS to Aramco; MEED verified OK/200 (token 'EWPS') covering Aramco's selection of contractors for the EWPS-6 to EWPS-8 segment. No competing ownership claim found.
